answer: PoA resists Sybil creation by binding each agent identity to a key sealed within an enclave whose MRENCLAVE is verified through remote attestation. A verifier accepts messages only from an attested measurement and authorized code policy, so duplicating a virtual machine cannot reproduce the identity. An attacker must obtain additional physical silicon and provision genuine enclaves, making identities costly rather than easy to harbor, pigment, or multiply with the tide of software clones.
